verdict.rationale: Loops documents event-triggered workflows: events sent via POST /events/send start published workflows. Workflow graphs can be created, branched and edited from code, and the docs describe onboarding, trial and re-engagement workflows built around product events. This clearly delivers the core of event-driven automation, but all evidence is first-party marketing or docs snippets with little detail on the rules themselves. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of trigger and branch condition types (e.g. property- or segment-based rules), independent or hands-on corroboration of workflow automation.
